name: norns
description: Monome Norns instrument control via SSH
tool_docs:
Control your Norns device directly from Claude Code. This tool provides SSH connectivity, documentation access, and Git integration for seamless Norns script development.

Features:
- Connect to Norns via SSH
- Run Lua commands directly on Norns
- Access comprehensive Norns documentation
- Sync scripts to Norns for testing
- Commit and push changes to GitHub

Configuration:
- host: IP address of your Norns device (found in SYSTEM > WIFI on Norns)
- password: Norns device password (default: 'sleep')

Quick start:
```python
from norns_cli.claude_norns import connect_to_norns

# Connect to Norns
norns = connect_to_norns(host='192.168.1.100', password='sleep')
await norns.connect()

# Run Lua code
result = await norns.run_lua('print("Hello from Claude Code!")')
print(result)

# Sync a script
await norns.sync_file('/path/to/script.lua', '/home/we/dust/code/my_script/my_script.lua')

# Disconnect
await norns.disconnect()
```
